message.text:
h13.

**Implementation: the unexported `*markdown.service` (goldmark-backed) — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`, the only type satisfying the interface. Construction: `markdown.NewService` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`), called exactly once in production at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` inside `NewAPIV1Service`. Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), plus the interface passed as a parameter to `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).**

The interface is `markdown.Service` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`, with eight methods covering extraction (`ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`), rendering (`RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`), and utilities (`GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`). There is exactly one implementation: the unexported `service` struct wrapping a single `goldmark.Markdown` value. I confirmed uniqueness by searching for any other declaration of the distinctive `ExtractAll(content []byte)` signature — the only hits are the interface method at line 33 and `(*service).ExtractAll` at line 356. No mocks or fakes implement it anywhere, including tests.

Construction is centralized. `NewAPIV1Service` builds the single runtime instance with both custom extensions enabled:

```47:56:server/router/api/v1/v1.go
func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
	return &APIV1Service{
		Secret:                   secret,
		Profile:                  profile,
		Store:                    store,
		MarkdownService:          markdownService,
```

`NewService` composes goldmark with GFM plus the optional `TagExtension` and `MentionExtension` and enables auto heading IDs (lines 91-108), returning `Service` rather than the concrete type.

That one instance is then shared rather than duplicated: `server/server.go:85` passes `apiV1Service.MarkdownService` into `rss.NewRSSService`, so the RSS feed renderer (`RenderHTML` at `server/router/rss/rss.go:339`) uses the same goldmark configuration as the API. Within the API layer it's used for mention extraction (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`), webhook snippet generation (`memo_service_webhooks.go:85`), and memo payload rebuilds on create and update (`memo_service.go:108` and `:447`).

One wrinkle on the third holder: `memopayload.Runner` declares a `MarkdownService markdown.Service` field and `NewRunner` accepts one, but nothing constructs that runner in production — the API layer calls the package-level `RebuildMemoPayload` directly and passes the interface as an argument instead. So `Runner`'s holding of the interface is dead code, consistent with its unused `RunOnce`.

Test code constructs its own instances — `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`, and `server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54` — but those are still the same `*service` type, sometimes with fewer extensions enabled.
